content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the trade list screen, the rowgroup scroll container is scrolled down by 225 px and back up to 0 px repeatedly with no click, input, or filter event between reversals, which suggests the list has no in-place way to narrow or locate rows, so the user is scanning it by hand.", "fix": "Fix: on the trade list screen, add a search or filter input above the rowgroup scroll container (or a sticky header row inside it) so users can narrow rows without repeated scrolling up and down.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:33", "292", "299", "305", "310", "316", "322", "328", "app:42", "300", "306", "312", "318", "324", "329", "335"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The row or value the users were looking for is not identifiable from the events.", "No filter, sort, or search element is visible in the windows, so whether one exists on the screen is unknown.", "Pointer samples between reversals were dropped (169 and 164), so the exact cursor path is incomplete.", "The scroll_y values are shown as 225 and 0, so the full list length is known only from the insight's 1.7x extent figure.", "Whether the reversals are caused by row data, layout, or a hidden control is not shown in the events."]}
